answer: Newcomers start on a narrow ledge: a sponsor stakes 40 POA behind each one, with rewards capped until it proves itself. Reputation decays — each idle epoch it falls by a delta of 5 points, and a canyon opens between active and stale identities. Below 50 the slot closes and the stake is slashed. Farming 100 fakes locks 4,000 POA plus work to fight decay. An honest agent pays one stake once, keeps full rewards, and its reputation compounds.
